house.description: Moorhead; funding provided to establish a cultural mall, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to establish a cultural mall in the city of Moorhead.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MOORHEAD CULTURAL MALL. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Immigrant Development Center, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to preserve and enhance the arts and cultural heritage of diverse Minnesota communities by establishing a cultural mall in the city of Moorhead. The grant may be used to acquire, renovate, and upgrade a property for this purpose. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to establish a cultural mall in the city of Moorhead.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MOORHEAD CULTURAL MALL.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Immigrant Development Center, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to preserve and enhance the arts and cultural heritage of diverse Minnesota communities by establishing a cultural mall in the city of Moorhead. The grant may be used to acquire, renovate, and upgrade a property for this purpose.
